dataType.title: What to scrape
dataType.description: reviews = player reviews for the given games; games = the store record for each game (price, genres, developer, review score summary, optional live player count).

apps.title: Games
apps.description: Steam store URLs or numeric App IDs, e.g. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/ or 1145360. Leading/trailing spaces are ignored.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Find games by name instead of (or as well as) giving URLs. Each match is then scraped according to 'What to scrape'.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per game
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Reviews only: how many reviews to SCAN per game before moving to the next one (max 5000). This counts reviews looked at, before the keyword/minPlaytimeHours filter is applied — a low cap combined with a narrow filter can return far fewer matches than actually exist deeper in Steam's feed. Raise it if the log warns the cap was hit while filtering.

maxResults.title: Max results (total)
maxResults.description: Hard cap on rows pushed to the dataset across all games — also caps what you are charged.

language.title: Review language
language.description: Steam language code for the reviews to return: english, schinese, russian, german, french, spanish, japanese, brazilian, ... or "all" for every language.

reviewType.title: Recommended / not recommended
reviewType.description: positive = thumbs-up reviews only, negative = thumbs-down only.

purchaseType.title: Purchase type
purchaseType.description: steam = reviews from players who bought the game on Steam (excludes key activations and free weekends).

includeOffTopic.title: Include off-topic review bombs
includeOffTopic.description: Steam hides reviews from periods Valve flagged as off-topic review-bomb activity (a controversy rather than the game itself). Turn this on to get the unfiltered set — e.g. Total War: ROME II returns 88,334 reviews filtered vs 94,228 unfiltered. Also applies to the review totals on Game details rows.

sortBy.title: Sort / selection
sortBy.description: recent = newest first, updated = most recently edited first, all = Steam's helpfulness ranking. Note: Steam itself defaults 'all' to only the last 30 days unless you also set 'Last N days' below.

dayRange.title: Last N days (helpfulness mode only)
dayRange.description: With Sort = Most helpful, restrict to reviews from the last N days (1-365). Steam applies a 30-day window by default in that mode if you leave this blank, so set it to 365 for a true all-time 'most helpful' pull. Ignored in the other sort modes, which are already chronological.

reviewsAfter.title: Reviews after (ISO date)
reviewsAfter.description: e.g. 2024-01-01. Keep only reviews created on or after this date. Unlike 'Last N days', this reaches any point in a game's history, not just the last year. Forces Sort to 'Most recent' so the date window can be applied correctly.

reviewsBefore.title: Reviews before (ISO date)
reviewsBefore.description: e.g. 2024-06-30. Keep only reviews created before this date. Combine with 'Reviews after' for an exact historical window (e.g. reviews from a specific patch or controversy). Forces Sort to 'Most recent'.

minPlaytimeHours.title: Minimum playtime (hours)
minPlaytimeHours.description: Keep only reviews from players with at least this many hours in the game — a cheap way to drop drive-by reviews.

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Keep only reviews whose text contains this word or phrase (case-insensitive), e.g. "crash", "controller", "price". Leading/trailing spaces are ignored. Accented letters are Unicode-normalized before matching, so "très" matches regardless of which Unicode form (composed or decomposed) you typed it in.

country.title: Country / currency
country.description: Two-letter country code used for store prices and availability (us, gb, de, ...).

includeGameInfo.title: Attach game info to every review
includeGameInfo.description: Adds gameName, developers, publishers, genres, releaseDate and storeUrl to each review row (one extra request per game).

includePlayerCount.title: Include live player count
includePlayerCount.description: Game details only: also fetch the current concurrent player count for each game (one extra request per game).

searchLimit.title: Games per search term
searchLimit.description: How many games to take from each search term (max 50).

watchLabel.title: Watch label (alert mode)
watchLabel.description: Set a name (e.g. "my-game-reviews") to turn this run into a watch: the FIRST run for a given label + filter set records which reviews already exist and returns nothing (0 charged). Every run after that returns only reviews posted since the last run under the same label, so you can schedule this Actor and get alerted on new reviews without re-paying for ones you already have. Changing any filter (apps/searchTerms/searchLimit/country/language/reviewType/purchaseType/includeOffTopic/sortBy/dayRange/keyword/minPlaytimeHours/reviewsAfter/reviewsBefore) starts a fresh baseline. Reviews only — ignored when dataType is "games". Leave empty for normal one-off runs.
